## Frequently asked questions

Some of the most frequently asked questions.

**How is Talowiz priced?**

Talowiz runs on a pure credit based model. You only pay when Talowiz agents perform hiring tasks.

**What exactly am I paying for?**

Credits are used across the entire hiring process — from intake and filtration to assessments, AI interviews, routing, and automation. You’re paying for hiring activity, not seats or logins.

**Do I need to commit to a plan or subscription?**

No commitment required. There are no fixed plans, retainers, or recurring platform fees. You use Talowiz only when you need it.

**What happens when hiring demand increases?**

As hiring activity grows, credit usage increases proportionally. You can add credits anytime without changing contracts or upgrading plans.

**How do I get started with Talowiz?**

Email shubhanshu@talowiz.com, and our team will guide you through the process.

**Is there any setup or implementation cost?**

No. There are no onboarding, implementation, or platform access fees.
